messages.subject: For Stina Johansen | Sustainability, External Affairs & Strategic Stakeholder Leadership | Executive Proposal
messages.body:
Dear Ms. Johansen,

I am writing from Guyana, where I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My work spans sustainability, government relations, regulatory coordination, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy and executive issue management in a major regulated industrial environment.

Ramboll's work across environment, energy, infrastructure and management consulting strongly aligns with the problems I handle today: translating regulatory and stakeholder complexity into executive decisions, connecting sustainability ambition to operating delivery and coordinating across public institutions, communities and internal functions.

I prepared a Ramboll Norway-specific Strategic Value Creation Proposal rather than sending a conventional CV alone. It outlines where I would add value across sustainability advisory, external affairs, stakeholder intelligence and emerging-market strategy. My three-page Executive CV forms the final section.

I am open to relocation to Norway and employer-supported work authorization. My strongest fit would be a Director, Head or senior leadership role spanning Sustainability, Environment, External Affairs, Government Relations, Strategic Advisory, Stakeholder Management or emerging-market client work.

I would value a short confidential conversation. If another senior leader, including the Managing Director or Environment and Health leadership, owns the most relevant mandate, I would be grateful if you would route the proposal internally.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director, Social Responsibility
AGM Inc. | Zijin Mining Group
ragunauthramsaroop@icloud.com
ragunauthramsaroop.com

strategic_brief.title: Strategic Value Creation Proposal: Sustainability Advisory, External Affairs and Stakeholder Leadership
strategic_brief.executive_summary: Ramboll Norway works across environment, energy, transport, water, buildings and management consulting, with sustainability embedded in its advisory proposition. Clients operating in regulated industries increasingly need more than technical analysis. They need integrated advice that connects environmental obligations, government expectations, stakeholder concerns, ESG evidence and operating realities. I bring director-level experience from a multinational mining operation where these interfaces are managed every day across regulators, ministries, communities and internal business functions. My contribution would be to strengthen the bridge between sustainability advisory and practical stakeholder execution, especially for clients facing complex permitting, public-policy, responsible-business and emerging-market challenges.
strategic_brief.company_context: Ramboll has a significant Norwegian presence and positions its work around sustainable societies, environmental performance and multidisciplinary consulting. Its recent Norway leadership hiring in Environment and Health highlights a commercial ambition to grow client impact around environmental, regulatory and societal challenges. Ramboll Norway also combines local expertise with a global platform, which creates opportunities to support clients whose projects sit across jurisdictions or involve complex public-sector and stakeholder interfaces. Many such clients need a clearer connection between technical sustainability work and the institutional conditions that determine project delivery. A practical advisory layer covering stakeholder strategy, regulatory coordination, commitment governance and executive issue management can increase the value of technical recommendations and improve implementation outcomes.

opportunities.title: Stakeholder strategy within environmental advisory
opportunities.rationale: Environmental and infrastructure projects frequently face delays or reputational pressure not because the technical work is weak, but because stakeholder expectations, public institutions and decision pathways are insufficiently mapped and managed early.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would add a structured stakeholder and government-relations layer to selected advisory engagements, connecting technical recommendations to decision-makers, commitments, communication needs and practical execution risks.

opportunities.title: Regulatory and institutional intelligence
opportunities.rationale: Clients operating across energy, mining, infrastructure and industrial sectors need concise interpretation of regulatory developments and institutional priorities, especially when projects cross multiple agencies or involve evolving sustainability standards.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would develop executive-level regulatory and institutional intelligence that identifies material developments, maps dependencies and translates external changes into client actions, owners and decision points.

opportunities.title: ESG evidence and assurance readiness
opportunities.rationale: Corporate sustainability commitments increasingly require defensible evidence, source ownership and traceability. Advisory value rises when environmental and social recommendations are connected to data governance and implementation controls from the start.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would support clients with commitment registers, evidence ownership, review routines and assurance-ready operating structures informed by direct experience in carbon-data governance and regulated industrial reporting.

opportunities.title: Emerging-market advisory growth
opportunities.rationale: Fast-growing resource economies require multidisciplinary advice spanning environment, infrastructure, energy, institutions and stakeholder legitimacy. Firms that combine technical depth with practical country-facing execution are better positioned to win and retain senior client mandates.
opportunities.how_i_can_help: I would help shape market-specific advisory propositions for resource and infrastructure clients, bringing direct operating experience from Guyana and a strong understanding of government, regulatory and stakeholder interfaces.

days_0_30: Map priority Norway and international client sectors where stakeholder or regulatory complexity limits implementation.
Review selected sustainability and Environment and Health engagements for gaps between technical advice and execution.
days_31_60: Develop a practical stakeholder and commitment-governance module that complements existing technical services.
Pilot an executive regulatory-intelligence format for selected industrial or infrastructure clients.
days_61_90: Apply the approach to live client opportunities and measure decision usefulness, issue visibility and implementation quality.
Create a concise playbook for integrating external affairs, stakeholder strategy and ESG evidence into multidisciplinary projects.
days_91_180: Scale the strongest methods across selected sectors or markets.
Build a pipeline of senior client conversations around regulated growth, sustainability execution and emerging-market complexity.

potential_impact: Stronger implementation outcomes from sustainability and environmental advisory engagements.
Earlier visibility of stakeholder and regulatory risks affecting client projects.
Higher-value executive advisory propositions for regulated industries and emerging markets.
Closer integration of ESG evidence, public institutions and operating execution.
background_relevance: Director-level experience across sustainability, government relations, regulatory coordination, corporate affairs, social performance and executive advisory in a multinational resource company.
Senior engagement with mining, environmental, energy, labour, standards, taxation, trade and investment institutions, with cross-functional execution responsibility.
Experience connecting renewable-energy, carbon-data and ESG commitments to source evidence, accountable owners and management decisions.
Direct operating perspective from Guyana, a fast-growing resource economy with complex infrastructure, regulatory and stakeholder demands.
